SGLT-2 inhibitors - drugs ending in “-flozin” – do NOT use if person has had DKA. Ensure person is eating and drinking before restarting and remind the person of ‘Sick day rules’ as SGLT2 inhibitors should be temporarily stopped during any illness causing dehydration.
